basic_details.job_title: IIIT Delhi Project Engineer and Estate Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology Delhi (IIITD) has one unreserved (UR) post of Project Engineer and Estate Officer at Pay Level 12, under Advt. No. 36/ 2026. IIITD is a State University set up by the IIIT-Delhi Act 2007 by the Govt. of NCT of Delhi. The job is on contract, at first for five years. It needs a Degree in Engineering (Civil/Electrical)/equivalent with at least 55% marks and 12 years' experience. Candidates must apply online on the IIITD recruitment portal between 21 October 2026 and 11 November 2026, 5 PM.

content_sections.heading: About IIIT Delhi
content_sections.text: Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology Delhi (IIITD) is a State University in Delhi, set up by the IIIT-Delhi Act 2007 by the Govt. of NCT of Delhi. The Registrar issued Advt. No. 36/ 2026 on 21 October 2026. The post is filled under the Institute's Recruitment and Promotion Rules for Non-Teaching Staff – 2024.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives the following for the Project Engineer and Estate Officer post (as per recruitment rules 2024): Degree in Engineering (Civil/Electrical)/equivalent with good academic records (minimum 55% marks); and a total of 12 years' experience, out of which at least 8 years of relevant experience at Pay Level-10, or equivalent experience for those working in private organizations. Some more rules from the notice: The Institute also reserves the right to relax age or experience in exceptional cases. It may also do so for candidates who already hold an analogous post in a teaching/Research & Development Organization/Industry. For the full eligibility rules of the post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Pay: Pay Level 12. The notice says deserving candidates may be given a higher starting salary, additional increments or pay protection. Nature of appointment: The post is contractual. It is at first for a period of five years, or as recommended by the Selection Committee. It can be extended as per Institute norms and the Recruitment and Promotion Rules for Non-Teaching Staff – 2024. Posting: The selected candidate can be placed in any administrative department/division of the Institute.

content_sections.heading: IIIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these points under "Desirable Skill Set / Indicative Job Description" for the Project Engineer and Estate Officer: Prepare estimates for various civil, electrical, mechanical, and sanitary work undertaken or proposed by the institute. Prepare progress reports on on-going work and report the same to the authorities of the institute on a monthly basis. Supervise the execution of the works in all civil, electrical, and gardening work, according to the norms and standards. Ensure the successful achievement of the targets fixed for completion of each project, with due consideration for speed and economy of scale, and/or proper maintenance of building structures, water supply channels, and regular maintenance of all the electric generators, and ensuring proper use of the same. Invite and open quotations related to the Estate Office through committees duly constituted for the purpose; examine/recommend the tenders for acceptance/rejection with proper justification and notes. Conduct various audits related to the safety of buildings, disability, etc.; inspect the buildings, structures and road, etc. under his/her charge as often as necessary, examine their condition from safety and maintenance point of view and take/suggest necessary action. Test/check the measurements recorded in the M. Books and certify. Ensure compliance with all the provisions of the Labor Laws and/or guidelines of the regulatory authorities in respect of the workers engaged by the working contractors in the Institute or workers hired through approved agencies. Advise the Director and Registrar in all technical matters and ensure that all work executed is as per the guidelines prescribed by the MOA/ Bye-Laws/ CPWD/State's PWO and that these works are carried out with the authorization/approval of the Works Committee or Building Committee, etc., as per the prescribed procedure. Provide support for the next phase of construction at the Campus.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIIT Delhi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Make sure you meet the eligibility criteria before you apply. The notice asks only eligible candidates to apply. Apply online on the IIITD recruitment portal: https://iiitd.nurecampus.com/NURE/OnlineRecruitmentApplication.action Pay the application fee of INR 590, unless you belong to an exempted group (see the fee table below). Submit the complete application by 11 November 2026, 5 PM. Incomplete applications, and applications whose fee is not paid, will be summarily rejected. If you are an internal candidate, inform the HR division and your Head of the Division when you apply. For questions about the recruitment portal, email [email protected] . The application fee of candidates who are not shortlisted will not be refunded.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A Screening Committee set up by the Competent Authority will check the applications for eligibility. If the number of applications is very large, the Institute can set additional shortlisting criteria or use higher eligibility/experience standards. Provisionally shortlisted applicants will be called for the further selection process, as decided by the Competent Authority. Shortlisted candidates will be informed only through the email address given in the application form.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No. 36/ 2026)?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, for the post of Project Engineer and Estate Officer (Post Code Recruitment/36/2026-01) in the FMS department. The post is unreserved (UR).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIIT Delhi Project Engineer and Estate Officer post?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 11 November 2026, 5 PM. Applications opened on 21 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the IIIT Delhi Project Engineer and Estate Officer post?
faq.answer: You need a Degree in Engineering (Civil/Electrical)/equivalent with good academic records (minimum 55% marks). You also need a total of 12 years' experience, of which at least 8 years must be relevant experience at Pay Level-10, or equivalent experience for those working in private organizations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIIT Delhi Project Engineer and Estate Officer post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 50, counted as on the last date of the advertisement, 11 November 2026. Age relaxation follows Government of India norms. Employees of the Institute get up to five years or their serving period, whichever is less.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for the IIIT Delhi Project Engineer and Estate Officer post?
faq.answer: The post is at Pay Level 12. The notice says deserving candidates may be given a higher starting salary, additional increments or pay protection.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for IIIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is INR 590 for each advertised post, and it is non-refundable. SC, ST, PwD and women candidates pay no fee, and internal candidates, including allied staff, are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for IIIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online at https://iiitd.nurecampus.com/NURE/OnlineRecruitmentApplication.action by 11 November 2026, 5 PM. Incomplete applications, and applications whose fee is not paid, will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be shortlisted for the IIIT Delhi Project Engineer and Estate Officer post?
faq.answer: A Screening Committee will check the applications for eligibility. If there are very many applications, the Institute may use additional shortlisting criteria. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email about the further selection process.

faq.question: Q9. Is the IIIT Delhi Project Engineer and Estate Officer post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is contractual, at first for five years or as recommended by the Selection Committee. It can be extended as per Institute norms and the Recruitment and Promotion Rules for Non-Teaching Staff – 2024.

faq.question: Q10. Is private-sector experience accepted for the IIIT Delhi Project Engineer and Estate Officer post?
faq.answer: Yes. Equivalent experience will be considered for candidates who apply while working in private organizations.
